presets.name: Central European self bow
presets.description: A tall, mildly reflexed wooden self bow with a historically grounded D-section working limb, horn tip overlays, and a served string with compact nocking loops.

presets.name: Reflex-recurve composite bow
presets.family: Archery bow · Central/Eastern European and Ottoman family
presets.description: A shorter reflex-recurve bow whose wood core, horn belly, and sinew backing remain visibly separate generated layers.

presets.name: Fletched flight arrow
presets.description: A parameterized wooden arrow with iron head, separate fletchings, and a real open nock slot sized to admit the bowstring.

presets.name: Leather arrow quiver
presets.description: A tapered leather quiver with a capped bottom, hollow interior and mouth, bound rim, and attached shoulder strap.

presets.name: German cranequin hunting crossbow
presets.description: An early Central European family reconstruction using the dimensions of altered Met 14.25.1572a: its later replacement prod and lock do not establish a 1544 mechanism. The modeled nut lock, bridle and spanning purchase are comparative construction.

presets.name: Composite-prod arbalest
presets.description: A horn-wood-sinew prod family retained alongside early steel prods, with substantial bridle binding, a working nut lock, and goat's-foot pivot lugs.

presets.name: Comparative light target crossbow
presets.description: A compact comparative study with a slender steel prod and belt-hook purchase surfaces; it is not presented as a sourced 1544 German object.

presets.name: Crossbow bolt / quarrel
presets.description: A short heavy quarrel with a flattened horn-reinforced butt that bears on the runner and nut shelf, never an arrow-style string nock.

presets.name: Broad German bolt quiver
presets.description: Layered wood, paper, hide, and leather carrier based on Met 29.158.646a-l: broad tapered body, open mouth, closed base, and attached strap.

presets.name: Peter Peck double-barreled wheellock pistol
presets.description: Parametric small arm anchored to Met 14.25.1425: 49.2 cm overall, stacked 25.4/19.4 cm barrels of 11.7 mm caliber, paired ignition trains, shallow swept cherry stock, gilt steel, and staghorn furniture.

presets.name: German matchlock arquebus
presets.description: Shoulder-fired matchlock anchored to Met 28.100.6: 160.3 cm overall, 121.6 cm barrel, 17.7 mm bore, and approximately 6.15 kg.

presets.name: Single-barrel wheellock pistol study
presets.description: Honestly labeled single-barrel wheellock endpoint for exploring the shared generator; not an exact reconstruction of Met 14.25.1425.

presets.name: Lead round ball
presets.description: Independent spherical lead projectile. Radius is its only adjustable parameter; choose bore radius minus documented windage.

presets.name: Small-arms ball pouch
presets.description: Independent leather ball pouch with open mouth, hinged flap, toggle, and two belt loops; contains no powder geometry.

presets.name: German halberd
presets.description: Compact forged head scaled to the Met's c.1525–50 German example (about 24.1 cm across), with narrow axe, downturned beak and central spike.

presets.name: Lucerne hammer
presets.description: Compact poll and narrow armour beak flow from a reinforced central socket into the top spike.

presets.name: Knightly pollaxe
presets.description: Compact armoured-fighting head with a waisted axe and shaped poll joined through a reinforced eye.

presets.name: Kriegsspieß / pike
presets.description: Long infantry pike with a compact diamond-section head and small reinforcing socket.

presets.name: Short spear
presets.description: General-purpose stout spear with a leaf-shaped blade and iron shoe.

presets.name: Partisan
presets.description: Broad spear blade forged continuously into short symmetrical basal lugs.

presets.name: German Kuse / glaive
presets.description: Curved single-edged blade with an integral narrow root seated inside the socket.

presets.name: Hooked bill
presets.description: Single forged bill outline with an exposed 8 cm recurved hook, top point and integral socket root.

presets.name: Military fork
presets.description: A single forged head flowing from socket root through crotch into tapered tines.

presets.name: Longsword
presets.description: Long fullered blade, straight cross, two-handed grip and scent-stopper pommel.

presets.name: Early Zweihänder
presets.description: Large fullered infantry sword with long grip, broad guard and parrying lugs.

presets.name: Katzbalger
presets.description: Short broad fullered blade with a compact c.14 cm figure-eight guard and joined fan cap.

presets.name: Großes Messer
presets.description: Broad curved blade, slab-and-tang grip, forged cross and visibly projecting Nagel.

presets.name: Dussack form study
presets.description: Non-curated parametric curved-blade and hand-bow study; retain for generator testing, not historical baseline scoring.

presets.name: Panzerstecher / estoc
presets.description: Long narrow stiff thrusting blade with a raised diamond section.

presets.name: Rondel dagger
presets.description: Stiff diamond-section thrusting dagger with paired correctly wound rondels.

presets.name: German Reitschwert
presets.description: Connected c.1540 German riding-sword hilt with diamond-section side ring, oval knuckle bow, and finger loop built from one named-node assembly. A pierced-shell construction study is available as an optional later-style stress case.

presets.name: Reiter war hammer
presets.description: Reference-scale 14 cm head with compact crowned poll, near-square faceted beak and long steel haft sleeve.

presets.name: Primitive bearded-axe study
presets.description: Generator stress-test for the shared axe primitive; excluded from the curated 1544 baseline.

presets.name: Compact flanged mace
presets.description: Compact endpoint of the shared sampled-flange system: gently curved sides, central cusps, steel haft and dark grip.

presets.name: Elongated Gothic flanged mace
presets.description: Reference-like endpoint of the same sampled generator: long inward-bowed flanges, high cusped shoulders, long sleeve, short pointed crown, steel haft, collars and near-black grip.

presets.name: Buckler
presets.description: Compact hand shield for sword fencing. Steel bowl and hollow boss; dimensions are authoring choices, not a museum reconstruction.

presets.name: Targe
presets.description: Generic strapped round shield. This is not a reconstruction of a German tournament targe.

presets.name: Round shield
presets.description: Broad round shield for construction experiments; not a curated 1544 German infantry type.

presets.name: Heater shield
presets.description: Older shield silhouette, retained for authoring studies rather than a typical 1544 German infantry baseline.

presets.name: Pavise
presets.description: Wooden shield with a raised center rib, informed by surviving late-fifteenth-century German pavises. Useful as older equipment in 1544.

presets.name: Kite shield
presets.description: Earlier medieval silhouette outside the 1544 German baseline.

presets.name: Roman tower shield
presets.description: Ancient shield construction study outside the 1544 setting.
